function.name: TwilioGetReceivedSmsMessages
function.description: Retrieve the history of received SMS messages.

from_phone_number.description: The phone number in E.164 format to retrieve the history for. If not specified, the history for all phone numbers will be retrieved.

datetime_range.description: A list of two timestamps in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' to retrieve the history between. If not specified, the history for all timestamps will be retrieved.

keywords.description: The comma-separated keywords to search for in the message content. If not specified, no keyword filtering will be performed.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to retrieve. Optional.

function.name: BinanceGetOrderHistory
function.description: Retrieve the user's order history for a specified date range and cryptocurrency pair.

date_range.description: An array containing the start and end dates of the date range, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

pair.description: The cryptocurrency pair to retrieve order history for, for example, 'BTCUSD', 'USDBTC', 'ETHUSD', etc. If not provided, retrieve order history for all pairs.

function.name: GmailSendEmail
function.description: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

to.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

cc.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

bcc.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

send_at.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

attachments.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.
